params.name: objectField
params.description: Object field to get distinct attribute values from; must be of the Object type

params.name: path
params.description: Dot-notation path of the attribute whose distinct values to get (case-sensitive)

params.name: valuesArray
params.description: Receives the non-repeated values; must be the same scalar array type (Text, number, Boolean, Date, or Time) as the values stored at path

overloads.semanticRole: Returns the non-repeated (unique) values found at a given nested attribute path of an Object field, for the current selection.

constraints: objectField must be of the Object type, otherwise an error is returned.

All values at path across the selection must be of the same scalar type (Text, number, Boolean, Date, or Time); mixed types (e.g. text in one record, number in another) generate an error. Pointers, objects, BLOBs, and images are not supported.
Can be used with indexed or non-indexed fields, but is slower on unindexed fields and loses the current record in that case.
Does not change the current selection or the current record.
